stories.title: Why Philly? Why not Cleveland or Miami? Here's eve...
stories.summary: LeBron James' decision creates massive questions for the 76ers, Cavaliers and Heat, as well as the legend who -- once again -- has rocked the NBA.

stories.title: Jones, Beltran, Kent enshrined in baseball's Hall
stories.summary: Different paths took Andruw Jones, Carlos Beltran and Jeff Kent to Cooperstown, but on Sunday they officially arrived.

stories.title: Source: Cards give Brissett $15.5M deal for '26
stories.summary: The Cardinals and quarterback Jacoby Brissett have reached agreement on a reworked contract that will pay him $15.5 million guaranteed this season with the chance to make $21 million with incentives, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Jeudy disputes video appearing to show QB pick
stories.summary: Browns wide receiver Jerry Jeudy is pushing back against a viral video in which he appears to show his preference on who he believes should be named the team's starting quarterback.

stories.title: Sources: Nuggets matching Jones' offer sheet
stories.summary: The Nuggets are matching the Thunder's fully guaranteed two-year, $12 million offer sheet to Spencer Jones, sources said.
